name: Excel to s3dgraphy Mapping (AI Data Collection)
description: Maps Excel tabular data to s3dgraphy Graph format. The Graph can then be exported to Extended Matrix GraphML via GraphMLExporter. IMPORTANT: This mapping creates s3dgraphy nodes (StratigraphicNode with attributes), NOT Extended Matrix nodes (which include ParadataNodeGroup). The transformation Excel→s3dgraphy→GraphML involves three different formalizations: (1) Excel: tabular structure for data entry/AI extraction, (2) s3dgraphy: extended graph with 3D nodes + EM concepts, (3) Extended Matrix GraphML: hypergraph with groups for paradata. The GraphMLExporter handles s3dgraphy→GraphML transformation (e.g., extractor/document attributes → ParadataNodeGroup + ExtractorNode + DocumentNode).

ID.description: Unique identifier (US/USM/USV/SF number) for the stratigraphic unit.

TYPE.description: Type of stratigraphic unit: US, USVs, USVn, SF, VSF, USD, serSU, serUSD, serUSVn, serUSVs, TSU, SE, BR

DESCRIPTION.description: Descrizione testuale dell'US. Finisce nel campo `description` del nodo stratigrafico, non in un PropertyNode: serve `target_id_column` per dire A QUALE nodo appartiene. Senza di quello `is_description` non trova il bersaglio e il testo si perde senza alcun avviso — misurato 2026-09-20.

PERIOD_START.description: Start date of the period (e.g., -753 for Roman Kingdom start).

PERIOD_END.description: End date of the period (e.g., 476 for Roman Empire end).

PHASE.description: Chronological phase within the period (e.g., Imperiale, Repubblicano).

OVERLIES.description: Comma-separated IDs of SUs that this SU lies upon (covers). Colonna di RELAZIONE: i valori sono NOMI di altre US, non un valore da registrare. Senza `is_relation` la colonna diventerebbe anche un PropertyNode e l'US comparirebbe due volte, come arco e come proprieta' testuale.

EXTRACTOR.description: Actor/agent identity for the stratigraphic definition extraction (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, Manual). NOTE: In Extended Matrix semantics, 'extractor' means a specific text passage or observation extracted from a document. This column stores the actor identity for the stratigraphic_definition property. Per-property extractors with proper EM semantics will be supported via the qualia properties file. STORED AS ATTRIBUTE on StratigraphicNode.

DOCUMENT.description: Source document for the stratigraphic definition (e.g., Report_2023.pdf, Field_notes_Day5.pdf). Should be a specific file reference, not a generic description. Per-property documents will be supported via the qualia properties file. STORED AS ATTRIBUTE on StratigraphicNode.
